presentationProfile.title: SendPilot
presentationProfile.description: Manage LinkedIn outreach campaigns, track lead statuses, and monitor credit balances with SendPilot

campaigns.get.description: Retrieves detailed configuration, lead metrics, and connected sender accounts for a specific campaign

campaigns.list.description: Retrieves a paginated list of LinkedIn outreach campaigns filtered by status

campaigns.update.description: Pauses or resumes an existing outreach campaign

credits.get.description: Retrieves current credit balances, subscription quota, and usage across workspace features

inbox.listConversations.description: Retrieves LinkedIn message threads across connected sender accounts with continuation token pagination

inbox.listMessages.description: Retrieves message history and attachments for a specific LinkedIn conversation thread

inbox.listSenders.description: Retrieves connected LinkedIn sender accounts along with daily message limits and usage

inbox.sendConnectionRequest.description: Dispatches a LinkedIn connection request with an optional note to a target profile.

inbox.sendMessage.description: Sends a direct message to a LinkedIn profile URL using a connected sender account

inbox.sendMessageToLead.description: Sends a templated LinkedIn message directly to an existing lead by lead ID

leadDatabase.filters.description: Lists supported lead filters. You can also search and paginate the bundled value catalog. This endpoint does not start a search or use credits.

leadDatabase.getSearchResults.description: Retrieves paginated lead records and contact details from a completed database search

leadDatabase.getSearchStatus.description: Checks the execution progress and completion status of a lead database search job

leadDatabase.startSearch.description: Initiates an asynchronous B2B lead search matching professional, company, and technology filters

leadExtractor.getResults.description: Retrieves paginated lead profiles, job history, and contact information from a finished extraction job

leadExtractor.getStatus.description: Retrieves the progress percentage and extraction status of a lead scraping campaign

leadExtractor.startExtraction.description: Launches a scraping job to extract and enrich leads from LinkedIn or Sales Navigator search URLs

leads.add.description: Adds one or more leads with profile attributes and custom fields to an outreach campaign

leads.get.description: Retrieves profile information, company data, and outreach history for a specific lead

leads.list.description: Retrieves a paginated list of leads filtered by campaign ID and outreach progress status

leads.updateStatus.description: Updates the progression status and notes for a specific lead

senders.quotas.displayName: Get daily LinkedIn quotas per sender
senders.quotas.description: Returns each sender's daily connection, message, and like quotas, including usage, remaining amounts, and reset times.

workspace.me.displayName: Get current API key and workspace
workspace.me.description: Returns details about the current API key and its workspace, including subscription status, scopes, expiration time, and rate limits.
